**Coelho · 2025 · 临床**

Neurometabolite Changes After Transcranial Photobiomodulation in Major Depressive Disorder

*Journal of Clinical Medicine* · [DOI: 10.3390/jcm14103402](https://doi.org/10.3390/jcm14103402) · [阅读全文](https://mdpi-res.com/d_attachment/jcm/jcm-14-03402/article_deploy/jcm-14-03402.pdf)

## 怎么做

```{=html}
<dl class="tp-study-fields">
<div><dt>研究对象</dt><dd>33 名重性抑郁障碍成人<br><a href="https://mdpi-res.com/d_attachment/jcm/jcm-14-03402/article_deploy/jcm-14-03402.pdf#page=1" target="_blank" rel="noopener">PDF 第 1 页｜样本与设计</a></dd></div>
<div><dt>研究设计</dt><dd>四条件随机交叉，约间隔一周<br><a href="https://mdpi-res.com/d_attachment/jcm/jcm-14-03402/article_deploy/jcm-14-03402.pdf#page=3" target="_blank" rel="noopener">PDF 第 3 页｜表 1</a></dd></div>
<div><dt>波长</dt><dd>808 nm<br><a href="https://mdpi-res.com/d_attachment/jcm/jcm-14-03402/article_deploy/jcm-14-03402.pdf#page=3" target="_blank" rel="noopener">PDF 第 3 页｜表 1</a></dd></div>
<div><dt>连续光 / 脉冲</dt><dd>低、中为连续；高档约 40 Hz、33% 占空比<br><a href="https://mdpi-res.com/d_attachment/jcm/jcm-14-03402/article_deploy/jcm-14-03402.pdf#page=3" target="_blank" rel="noopener">PDF 第 3 页｜表 1</a></dd></div>
<div><dt>照射位置</dt><dd>双侧背外侧前额叶 F3、F4<br><a href="https://mdpi-res.com/d_attachment/jcm/jcm-14-03402/article_deploy/jcm-14-03402.pdf#page=3" target="_blank" rel="noopener">PDF 第 3 页｜表 1</a></dd></div>
<div><dt>辐照度 / 功率</dt><dd>平均约 50、300、300 mW/cm²；高档峰值约 850<br><a href="https://mdpi-res.com/d_attachment/jcm/jcm-14-03402/article_deploy/jcm-14-03402.pdf#page=3" target="_blank" rel="noopener">PDF 第 3 页｜表 1</a></dd></div>
<div><dt>光斑</dt><dd>表 1 照射面积 24 cm²<br><a href="https://mdpi-res.com/d_attachment/jcm/jcm-14-03402/article_deploy/jcm-14-03402.pdf#page=3" target="_blank" rel="noopener">PDF 第 3 页｜表 1</a></dd></div>
<div><dt>照射时间与疗程</dt><dd>表 1 有效照射 1200、333、600 秒<br><a href="https://mdpi-res.com/d_attachment/jcm/jcm-14-03402/article_deploy/jcm-14-03402.pdf#page=3" target="_blank" rel="noopener">PDF 第 3 页｜表 1</a></dd></div>
<div><dt>剂量</dt><dd>约 60、100、180 J/cm²<br><a href="https://mdpi-res.com/d_attachment/jcm/jcm-14-03402/article_deploy/jcm-14-03402.pdf#page=3" target="_blank" rel="noopener">PDF 第 3 页｜表 1</a></dd></div>
<div><dt>对照怎么做</dt><dd>设备待机、可见指示光，无近红外照射<br><a href="https://mdpi-res.com/d_attachment/jcm/jcm-14-03402/article_deploy/jcm-14-03402.pdf#page=3" target="_blank" rel="noopener">PDF 第 3 页｜假刺激与盲法</a></dd></div>
<div><dt>观察指标</dt><dd>左额质子波谱 NAA、Cho、Cr；MADRS、SDQ<br><a href="https://mdpi-res.com/d_attachment/jcm/jcm-14-03402/article_deploy/jcm-14-03402.pdf#page=4" target="_blank" rel="noopener">PDF 第 4 页｜MRS 采集</a></dd></div>
<div><dt>测量时间</dt><dd>刺激前与刺激后约 15 分钟；另比较多次访视前波谱<br><a href="https://mdpi-res.com/d_attachment/jcm/jcm-14-03402/article_deploy/jcm-14-03402.pdf#page=4" target="_blank" rel="noopener">PDF 第 4 页｜MRS 采集</a></dd></div>
</dl>
```

## 结果怎么看

- 单次分析 NAA 从 7.52 到 8.12 mmol/L，但变化未显示条件间显著差异。（[PDF 第 9 页｜单次 NAA 分析](https://mdpi-res.com/d_attachment/jcm/jcm-14-03402/article_deploy/jcm-14-03402.pdf#page=9)）

## 对实验设计有什么用

先检验主动对假刺激的变化差，再判断脑指标能否解释症状变化。不同档位同时改变了时间、辐照度或脉冲方式。
